SEC filing / transaction agreement fixture excerpt. This local test fixture represents an authoritative SEC filing or signed stock purchase agreement excerpt; it is not the Bohan Jin / FronThera case PDF and is not model memory.

The stock purchase agreement dated March 5, 2021 describes the March 2021 sale of FronThera to the acquiring vehicle. The agreement identifies FronThera as the acquired company and FL2021-001 / Esker Therapeutics / Alumis as the buyer-side lineage relevant to the acquisition. The transaction economics include $60M base initial consideration, up to $120M milestone consideration, and $180M maximum aggregate headline value.
